din604.source: DIN 604 flat countersunk nib bolt (Senkschraube mit Nase), M12: head diameter dk=24.65 (tabulated 23.35-24.65) and head height k=7.0 (max), nib width nib_w=3.6 (g, tabulated 3.12-3.6), confirmed by fasteners.eu DIN 604 table + Fuller Fasteners DIN 604 specifications + boltingspecialist.com DIN 604 (all M12 dk-max 24.65, g-max 3.6, head-angle 90-95 deg). nib_d=5.7 is the tabulated M12 'i' minimum, read as the nib height per fasteners.eu ('i - height of the nose', min 5.7) and Fuller (i min 5.7); boltingspecialist reads the same 5.7/7.0 pair as the head-depth range, so the nib-depth reading is flagged as the two-of-three interpretation. Per the DIN 604 figure (fasteners.eu drawing) the nib is a rib ON the conical bearing surface, hanging from the flat top face down by i -- NOT a lug on the shank (that is the DIN 607 form); the generator places it at z in [k-nib_d, k]. nib_l=12.3 REPRESENTATIVE (the radial reach is not tabulated; drawn flush with the head rim, just under dk/2=12.325, per the figure where the nib's outer face meets the rim; the 15-deg underside slope is omitted -- envelope box). d_shank=12.0 (M12 major, envelope-only, no drawn thread); length=50.0 REPRESENTATIVE (DIN 604 lists lengths 20-160); tip_chamfer=1.2 REPRESENTATIVE 45-degree lead. Envelope only - no thread, no drive (the nib is the anti-rotation feature).

din604d.source: DIN 604 M12, app image-variant key - identical flat countersunk nib-bolt envelope (dk=24.65, k=7, nib g=3.6/i=5.7); aliases the din604 base.

din607.source: DIN 607 cup (round) head nib bolt (Flachrundschraube mit Nase), M12: head diameter dk=24.65 (tabulated 23.35-24.65) and head height k=9.65 (tabulated 8.75-9.65), nib width nib_w=3.6 (g, tabulated 3.12-3.6) and nib depth nib_d=3.2 (i, min), confirmed by Fuller Fasteners DIN 607 specifications (M12: dk 23.35-24.65, k 8.75-9.65, g 3.12-3.6, i min 3.2, head radius r approx 13.3) + fasten.it DIN 607 table (M12: dk-max 24.65, k 8.75-9.65, g-max 3.6, i-min 3.2; grade C, sizes M8-M16). The dome is drawn as the spherical cap through dk/k (the tabulated r approx 13.3 matches the derived cap radius 12.7 within its 'approx' tolerance). nib_l=7.8 REPRESENTATIVE (radial reach not tabulated; derived from the figure's 30-degree underside slope and the tabulated i: d_shank/2 + i*tan(30deg) = 6 + 1.85; the nib is drawn as a triangular wedge hugging the bearing face, per the DIN 607 figure). drawn protruding 3 mm past the 6 mm shank radius, inside the head outline). d_shank=12.0 (M12 major, envelope-only, no drawn thread); length=50.0 REPRESENTATIVE stock length; tip_chamfer=1.2 REPRESENTATIVE 45-degree lead. Envelope only - no thread, no drive (the nib is the anti-rotation feature).

din607d.source: DIN 607 M12, app image-variant key - identical cup-head nib-bolt envelope (dk=24.65, k=9.65, nib g=3.6/i=3.2); aliases the din607 base.
